batches.brief: Convert jobs/parse_custbill_fixedwidth.sh + jobs/finance_excel_report.pl into Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline ow_tp_custbill_ldp: custbill_feed -> parsed_records (6-field CBCUST01 parse, ISO dates, implied-decimal amounts) with data expectations (length, date, currency in USD/EUR/GBP, record_type 01/02) routing rejects to ow_tp_custbill.quarantine; finance_billing_totals = month-end rollup keyed (currency, record_type) matching finance_billing_*.csv columns RecordCount/TotalAmount. Local plugin patches required BEFORE recon (apply to your session's plugin cache copy of skills/data-reconciliation/harness/recon/adapters.py): (1) in _uc_schema_facts change tp.grantee <> t.owner to tp.grantee <> t.table_owner (UC exposes table_owner); (2) inside _databricks_connect use sql.connect(server_hostname=host, http_path=http_path, access_token=_databricks_bearer()) for oauth-m2m (the connector's oauth_client_* kwargs drive interactive U2M and hang headless). Recon invocations: pass --target-http-path /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 (the FULL warehouse path, not the bare id — bare id fails OpenSession). Override stale env DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH with that path for every recon and grants probe.
